legal.privacy.metaDescription: Privacy information for julerothe.com, its contact form and newsletter.
legal.privacy.overview.heading: General information
legal.privacy.overview.p1: This privacy notice explains which personal data is processed when you use julerothe.com, for what purposes it is processed and which rights you have. Personal data means information that can identify you directly or indirectly.
legal.privacy.overview.p2: Depending on how you use the website, we process technical access data, information from contact requests and, where applicable, newsletter subscription data. Unless stated otherwise, personal data is processed only as necessary for the respective purpose.
legal.privacy.controller.heading: Data controller
legal.privacy.controller.p1:
The controller responsible for processing personal data on this website is:
Jule Rothe
Electric Avenue
Wolfgang-Heinze-Straße 16
04277 Leipzig
Germany
legal.privacy.controller.p2: For privacy enquiries and to exercise your rights, you can write to the address above or use the contact form on julerothe.com.
legal.privacy.lawful.heading: Purposes and legal bases
legal.privacy.lawful.p1: We process personal data on the basis of Article 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent), Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract and pre-contractual steps), Article 6(1)(c) GDPR (legal obligations) or Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interests). The applicable legal basis is explained for each processing activity.
legal.privacy.hosting.heading: Hosting, domain and DNS
legal.privacy.hosting.p1: Our website is hosted by Netlify (Netlify, Inc., USA). The julerothe.com domain is registered with STRATO. The hosting and DNS providers process technical access data when the website is visited. This enables secure, stable and efficient delivery. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in providing a functional and secure website).
legal.privacy.logs.heading: Technical access data and server logs
legal.privacy.logs.p1: When you access the website, hosting providers may record IP address, request date and time, requested file or URL, HTTP status, transferred data volume, referrer URL, and browser or device information. This supports delivery of the website, troubleshooting and protection against misuse and attacks. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
legal.privacy.logs.p2: Storage and deletion of these logs depend on the actual hosting setup and the provider's retention periods.
legal.privacy.contact.heading: Contact form and enquiries
legal.privacy.contact.p1: If you use the contact form, we process your name, email address and message content. Technical information may also be processed to transmit the message and prevent spam. We use these details to handle your enquiry and reply. Please do not submit health information or other particularly sensitive information through this public form.
legal.privacy.contact.p2: We use Formspree (Formspree, Inc., USA) to transmit contact form submissions. Appointment and project enquiries are processed under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR; other enquiries are processed under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. We delete enquiries once they have been resolved unless statutory obligations or legitimate reasons require continued storage.
legal.privacy.newsletter.heading: Newsletter and EmailOctopus
legal.privacy.newsletter.p1: We use EmailOctopus, a service provided by Three Hearts Digital Ltd in the United Kingdom, for our monthly newsletter. When you subscribe, we process at least your email address and the technical information required for registration, proof of consent, delivery and unsubscribing. The newsletter covers current tattoo projects, wanna-dos, appointment availability and walk-in events. Newsletter emails are sent on the basis of your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR.
legal.privacy.newsletter.p2: Newsletter subscriptions use double opt-in. You receive a confirmation email, and subscription and confirmation details are recorded as evidence of consent. You may withdraw consent with future effect at any time using the unsubscribe link in each newsletter. After unsubscribing, your address is removed from the active list unless a necessary suppression record or legal obligation justifies limited further retention.
legal.privacy.newsletter.p3: EmailOctopus may process delivery, opening and click statistics where those features have been enabled.
legal.privacy.embed.heading: Embedded third-party newsletter form
legal.privacy.embed.p1: To display the newsletter sign-up form, the homepage currently loads a script from EmailOctopus (eocampaign1.com) as soon as the page is opened. Technical data such as your IP address may therefore be transferred to the provider even before you subscribe. Depending on the integration, cookies or similar technologies may also be used.
legal.privacy.embed.p2: Where this involves non-essential storage of or access to information on a user's device, prior consent is generally required under Section 25 TDDDG. The GDPR also applies to any associated personal data.
legal.privacy.fonts.heading: Google Fonts
legal.privacy.fonts.p1: This website currently loads the Cormorant Garamond and Manrope typefaces directly via Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com). Your browser connects to Google's servers, which necessarily involves transmission of your IP address and may involve additional connection information.
legal.privacy.fonts.p2: The integration is intended to provide a consistent appearance.
legal.privacy.cookies.heading: Cookies, device access and language selection
legal.privacy.cookies.p1: The website's language selection uses the URL parameter ?lang=de or ?lang=en and, according to the current website code, does not require browser storage. The site's own code currently does not include analytics or advertising tracking. Third-party services, especially the embedded newsletter form, may nevertheless use their own technologies.
legal.privacy.cookies.p2: Section 25 TDDDG applies to cookies and similar device access that are not strictly necessary. Where consent is required, it must be obtained before use and be withdrawable.
legal.privacy.instagram.heading: Link to Instagram
legal.privacy.instagram.p1: The footer contains a link to our Instagram profile. According to the current code, this website does not embed an Instagram feed or an Instagram tracking pixel. If you click the external link, you leave this website; Instagram's operator is responsible for subsequent processing under its own notices.
legal.privacy.recipients.heading: Recipients and processors
legal.privacy.recipients.p1: Personal data is shared only with parties that need it for the purposes described above. These may include hosting and DNS providers, the contact form provider Formspree, the newsletter provider EmailOctopus and their authorised subprocessors. Where required by law, processors are engaged under data processing agreements pursuant to Article 28 GDPR.
legal.privacy.transfers.heading: International data transfers
legal.privacy.transfers.p1: Use of Netlify, Formspree, EmailOctopus and Google may involve processing outside the European Economic Area, particularly in the United States and the United Kingdom. The European Commission has issued an adequacy decision for the United Kingdom. Transfers to eligible certified US organisations may rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Otherwise, appropriate safeguards such as EU Standard Contractual Clauses may be required.
legal.privacy.retention.heading: Retention and deletion
legal.privacy.retention.p1: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described or for applicable legal retention obligations or legal claims. Contact enquiries are deleted after they have been handled and any relevant obligations have expired. Newsletter subscription details generally remain in the active list until unsubscribing.
legal.privacy.retention.p2: Technical logs, third-party data and consent records are subject to the applicable configured or statutory periods.
legal.privacy.rights.heading: Your rights
legal.privacy.rights.p1: Subject to the legal conditions, you have the right to access your personal data (Article 15 GDPR), rectification (Article 16), erasure (Article 17), restriction of processing (Article 18), data portability (Article 20), and objection to certain processing (Article 21). You may object to direct marketing at any time.
legal.privacy.rights.p2: You may withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before that point. To exercise your rights, please use the contact details above.
legal.privacy.complaint.heading: Right to lodge a complaint
legal.privacy.complaint.p1:
Under Article 77 GDPR, you have the right to complain to a supervisory authority, particularly where you habitually reside, work or where the alleged infringement occurred. In Saxony, the competent authority is the Saxon Commissioner for Data Protection and Transparency:
Maternistraße 17
01067 Dresden
Germany
Email: post@sdtb.sachsen.de
www.datenschutz.sachsen.de
legal.privacy.security.heading: Encryption and data security
legal.privacy.security.p1: The website is delivered over an encrypted HTTPS connection. We also use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data. Absolute security of data transmissions over the internet cannot be guaranteed.
legal.privacy.automation.heading: Automated decision-making
legal.privacy.automation.p1: According to the current website functionality, no decisions are made solely by automated processing that produce legal effects or similarly significantly affect you (Article 22 GDPR).
legal.privacy.updates.heading: Updates to this notice
legal.privacy.updates.p1: We update this privacy notice if legal requirements, services or data processing activities change. The version published on this website applies.
